remarks: *Please submit highest and best offers by 12pm Monday 5/4* Welcome to this beautifully updated 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath condo set within the highly desirable Fawn Ridge complex featuring pool and tennis courts. Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and style, this home features newer hardwood floors, updated windows, brand new hot water heater, and a versatile den/office just off the kitchen-perfect for a home office, playroom, or cozy sitting area. This unit also has a large finished basement for extra flex space in addition to overflow storage. The spacious and functional layout offers an ideal flow for everyday living and entertaining. Enjoy the warmer weather lounging on the back deck and take in the beautiful pool and courtyard view out the front door. Ideally located close to shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this is effortless living at its best!
